ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: in the upper part of the figure is a magnet; the left magnetic pole is labeled N, and the right magnetic pole is labeled S; the copper disk is located between the two magnetic poles. The copper disk is drawn as a vertical ellipse, and a horizontal axial wire passes through the center of the disk; the left end of the axial wire is labeled O1, and the right end is labeled O2. Near the edge of the copper disk, four contactable points a, b, c, and d are marked, among which a is located above and within the effective magnetic-field region between the two magnetic poles. Below is an ammeter, and the two terminals are labeled M and N. Then reason: in an induction-type copper-disk generator, when the copper disk rotates, the conductor part in the magnetic field cuts the magnetic induction lines, and the induced electromotive force is produced between the disk center/axis and the disk edge within the effective magnetic-field region. Therefore the ammeter cannot be connected only to the two axial terminals, nor can it be connected only to ineffective edge points; one end should be connected to the axial-wire terminal, and the other end to the disk-edge brush that is in the effective magnetic field. Combined with the figure, the effective disk-edge point is a; according to the standard connection method of the problem, M is connected to O1, and N is connected to a.

method.method_draft: 先读图：铜盘位于磁铁两极之间，N 极在左、S 极在右；铜盘的轴线导线水平穿过盘心，左右接线端标为 O1、O2；a、b、c、d 是可与铜盘边缘接触的四个电刷位置，其中 a 在磁场区域内的盘缘上方；电流表有 M、N 两个接线端。再读题：要求铜盘转动时怎样连接电流表才能观察到感应电流。应用感应式铜盘发电机规则：转动导体盘在磁场中切割磁感线，盘心/轴线与处于有效磁场中的盘缘之间产生感应电动势；若电流表只接两个轴线端或只接两个等势边缘点，不能形成有效感应电流。应将电流表一端接轴线导线端，另一端接有效盘缘电刷。结合图中可用且有效的盘缘接触点为 a，并按题目标准接法对应 M、N，得到 M 接 O1，N 接 a。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中上部是磁铁，左侧磁极标为 N，右侧磁极标为 S，铜盘位于两磁极之间；铜盘画成竖直椭圆，水平轴线导线穿过盘心，轴线导线左端标 O1，右端标 O2。铜盘边缘附近标出 a、b、c、d 四个可接触点，其中 a 位于上方且在两磁极之间的有效磁场区域内；下方是电流表，两个接线端标为 M、N。再推理：感应式铜盘发电机中，铜盘转动时，处在磁场中的导体部分切割磁感线，感应电动势产生在盘心/轴线与有效磁场区域内的盘缘之间。因此电流表不能只接两个轴线端，也不能只接无效边缘点；应一端接轴线导线端，另一端接处在有效磁场中的盘缘电刷。结合图中有效盘缘点为 a，按题目标准接法，M 接 O1，N 接 a。
method.model_answer: M 接 O1，N 接 a。
